Hyper-Expansion.description: High growth, low inflation, abundant liquidity.

Stagflationary Shock.description: Low growth, high inflation, restrictive monetary policy.

Deflationary Bust.description: Severe economic contraction, collapsing demand, liquidity crisis.

Idiosyncratic Credit Crunch.description: Sector-specific defaults causing localized contagion (e.g., Regional Banks, CRE).
